confirmed: The FOB is a navigable outdoor encampment in a wooded, mountainous setting.
The official overview shows a central rough path/clearing, small field structures, tented work areas, rocks, trees and communications equipment.
The Firing Range is a wooded grove with targets from close range to over 100 metres.
The Deploy threshold uses razor wire and leads to a heavy-lift military transport helicopter.
